result.summary: Overall the page renders cleanly with no critical or major visual defects. Layout, spacing, imagery, and typography are consistent. Only a couple of minor cosmetic/accessibility observations were found.

issues.description: The search field placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a light gray background, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios for some users.
issues.suggestion: Slightly darken the placeholder text color or lighten the input background to improve contrast while keeping it visually distinct from entered text.

issues.description: The white heart (favorite) icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image sits directly on the photo without a background scrim, so it could become hard to see on lighter images (the pizza card below uses a dark circular background, making the two cards inconsistent).
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent dark circular background behind the heart icon on all restaurant cards for consistency and guaranteed visibility.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under the 'Fastest near you' cards (e.g., '€0.90 delivery') uses a fairly light gray that borders on low contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Use a slightly darker gray for secondary metadata text to ensure readability, especially outdoors or on low-brightness screens.
